body:
Projects now have one optional Folder category; cards keep their existing tags and have no folder field. Focus filters across projects by folder, preserves hidden pin order and offers a project chooser when creating a card. Project folders autosave and can be cleared. Source/API contracts, CLI patches and examples are aligned.

The full local gate passed 215 Rust, 102 JavaScript and 12 Python tests, including subprocess durability. All 12 release Chromium suites pass across the documented runs, along with broad HTTPS smoke and planning checks. Two existing macOS FIFO test compilation problems were corrected without weakening validation. Cross-view project selection remains available after reloading Focus.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-26-project-folders.md. Existing manual service was not restarted; no live folder assignments, card status or release acceptance were changed.

metadata.summary: Added project folders and folder-based Focus filtering; card tags remain independent. Local gate and release browser verification pass.
